title: OS/VS COBOL BLL cells: READQ TS SET(cell) with SERVICE RELOAD, and a 5400-byte GETMAIN record over two cells (the second = the first + 4096) with a cell moved to another cell

scenarios.summary: WRITEQ TS then READQ TS SET(QPTR): after SERVICE RELOAD Q-REC the record holds the item (12 bytes) and LENGTH is 12
GETMAIN SET(FRPTR) FLENGTH(5400), FRPTR1 = FRPTR + 4096: FIELD3 (byte 5001 on) is in the second cell's 4096-byte span; TS-REC addressed by a copy of FRPTR sees the head written through FILE-REC
